items.text: All 4 round-2 decisions (mutual exclusion via shared isRecording flag, hook location at hooks/voice/wakeword/useWakeWordTest.ts with inline UI, recording bounds of 0.5s–3s, and plain div-based score bar with Tailwind) have been incorporated into plan.md. The plan now has complete contract decisions across both rounds, a fully specified hook API, phased implementation strategy with file locations, concrete unit test plan, and recording duration constraints.

Remaining gap: scope_defined is 2 because acceptance_allow and acceptance_deny could not be set via the backlog API (HTTP 405). Intended globs are documented in round-1 and round-2 info items: acceptance_allow should cover scenarios/web-console/ui/src/components/settings/** and scenarios/web-console/ui/src/hooks/voice/**. This does not block execution — the plan clearly defines which files are touched.

All other readiness dimensions score 3. The problem is fully understood, the approach is detailed with specific TypeScript interfaces and state machine transitions, the test plan covers hook state machine via renderHook with mocked engine plus manual verification steps, and risks have concrete mitigations (shared AudioContext, isRecording flag, 0.5s minimum recording duration).

plan_updates: Incorporated round-2 decisions: added Round 2 settled decisions table, specified hook file location (useWakeWordTest.ts), added recording duration bounds (0.5s min, 3s max auto-stop) to hook spec and target end state, detailed mutual exclusion mechanism (shared isRecording flag), specified div-based score bar implementation with Tailwind, added prohibited pattern for component extraction, updated testing plan with recording bounds tests and disabled-state tests, and refined definition of done with all new constraints.
